title: Podman not seeing container files
body:
Good day,

I am having an issue where podman (or systemd?) is unable to see container files located in `/home/user/.config/containers/systemd` even after running `systemctl daemon-reload`.
For the container, `example.container`, trying to run:
`systemctl --user start example`
results in:
`Failed to start example.service: Unit example.service not found.`

I did recently update my system, so I could see that being an issue, but I am fairly certain that podman did not update in the process. The files were able to be read from before to auto-launch containers on boot. I am not sure what changed.

Any advice is appreciated! Thank you and sorry for the trouble!

More info:
Podman Version: 5.4.2
OS: Debian Trixie 13.6

comments.body:
Alright, I figured it out I think. A new container I was trying to introduce has some issues for whatever reason, and when that one fails to start, so do all the other ones. Might have to do with the new one being multiple containers that includes a .pod file where my others are just .container files.

Guess I will need to look into fixing that if I still want to use it.
